name: pre-read-shared-victim-no-preemption-notice
description: Preemption-notice recording predicate: a notice is recorded ONLY for a victim that held M or E. Preflight: session A reads (SHARED), session B pre-edits (invalidating A's SHARED grant) then commits v2. A held SHARED — it had no grant to lose and no local edit stranded — so its stale re-read carries the stale-read warning ALONE. additionalContext is byte-asserted (the harness scrubs the two ISO timestamps): a prepended '⚠ Coordinator notice' block here means the recording predicate widened past M∪E.

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: ⚠ Stale read [warning emitted <TS>]: CLAUDE.md was updated by session 66666666 at <TS>. Current version is v2; you previously saw v1. Your worktree's content matches the last-recorded hash; the divergence is purely about version-tracking metadata. Consider re-reading CLAUDE.md before acting on stale assumptions.
